title: Overview

blocks.p: The base game plays through the “Heart of Sinnoh Campaign” with the following objectives split over three acts:

ol: Restore the Heart of Sinnoh and reach the Temple of Sinnoh for the final confrontation.

blocks.p: The first trainer to conquer all the objectives may claim victory.

ol: Ensure all trainers have selected a seat.

ol.text: The first trainer to choose a home village card is the last person to have seen a friend or relative from where they call home. This continues anti-clockwise until all trainers have selected a card:
items: Choose one of the two starter Pokémon and add it to your party.
Find the corresponding trainer token and place it on your village.
Place your home village card in your hand and it will automatically change your hand colour to the correct one.
Important: Now change your player colour to the new colour of the seat where your home village card is.

ol: Select the “Heart of Sinnoh Campaign” and click “Start Game”.
Draw the “Prologue” card from the acts deck and follow its instructions.
The trainer who was last to choose their home village card takes the first turn of the game. Turns then continue clockwise.

blocks.digital: In this game, you choose the campaign, home village and starter Pokémon when setting up the game, and the game places the tokens, colours and cards for you.

blocks.p: You may move up to 3 tiles per turn at the start of the game. The only restriction to movement is that you cannot move onto tiles that are 2 or more full elevations higher or lower than your current tile.
You may interact with things on the map whilst standing on their tile:

list: When you are on the same tile as another trainer, you can freely trade with them or challenge them to a battle (if they are outside of a village, the challenge cannot be denied).
You may continue to interact with things on the map until all of your movement for the turn runs out, but your turn immediately ends after any battle.

blocks.p: You may take each of these actions once per turn whilst at any village:

list: Fully restore your entire party: Remove all damage and status effects from your Pokémon.
Exchange your Apricorns with the Ginkgo Merchants according to one or both of the current Ginkgo Trades being offered (top-right of the map). Shuffle the Ginkgo Trade deck afterwards.
Fly to another village by discarding 1 Apricorn (there must be no Team Galactic Grunts on either village).

blocks.digital: In this game, you see and choose the current Ginkgo Trades on screen, and the game shuffles the deck for you.
